queries.rationale: The same high-priority target and anchor in Related Work (paper.tex:58) contrast scalar CQR (Romano2019) with joint residual rescaling without directly positioning adaptive multivariate regions. Seek complementary evidence on input-dependent residual scale and its calibration, not another scalar interval or conditional-validity survey. Inspect whether the construction covers the full response jointly, what varies with covariates, and which coverage assumptions are stated. Deduplicate against the first query and all 25 existing bibliography/provenance entries; one source may satisfy both directions.
